title: 2026-10-22_GSE_Omni-Cognitive_World_Model_Architecture_1G1CYptE
universal_lens: The transition from suppressed diagnostic overlays to active probability engines is mathematically unified via dynamic weighting of empirical situational priors. By excising zero-weight suppression, the system enforces a strict bijective mapping between verified literature and ranking probabilities, ensuring that physical context directly modulates market consensus without hallucination. Multi-layer HNSW graph traversal with dual-frequency spectral routing enables rapid retrieval of causally relevant premises from verified literature, integrating high-dimensional embeddings with structured symbolic reasoning.
gsi_mapping: GSI maps these primitives through Bayesian updating where external directional opinions are treated as noisy observations. The Price Rule acts as a conformal inference filter, re-pricing historical wagers against live exchange tape to quantify consumed Closing Line Value, thereby isolating true predictive alpha from exhausted syndicate steam. GSI leverages the HNSW indexing and BRIDGE routing to compute validated causal traces through Bayesian inference over structured knowledge graphs, ensuring integrity via 38-Gate bus verification.
gse_mapping: Within GSE, situational reasoning operates as a state-transition mechanism. Empirical evaluators—such as altitude fatigue decay or coaching tendencies—directly adjust factor breakdowns for Spread and Totals. Fail-closed entity resolution ensures that taxonomic divergences across bookmakers do not introduce collinear noise into the Layer-2 scoring engine. GSE employs the multi-stage causal engine to model dynamic game states, using symbolic Jacobians and second-order Hessians to simulate real-time strategic transitions and player interaction dynamics.

primitives.name: Dynamic Corpus Adjustment Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: In process-sport.ts (lines 1378–1395), legacy zero-weight suppression on corpusAdjustment was excised, setting corpusWeight: 1.0 dynamically so that verified literature and situational shifts directly adjust the model ranking probability (rankingP) over the de-vigged market baseline.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: corpusWeight: dimensionless scalar [0, 1]; rankingP: probability mass [0, 1]
primitives.assumptions: Verified literature provides non-zero information gain relative to the de-vigged market baseline.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down when situational priors become perfectly collinear with market consensus, rendering corpusWeight redundant.

layer2.mapping: Directly maps to the activation of Layer-2 situational scoring by removing artificial zero-suppression on empirical priors.
layer2.telemetry: Variance in rankingP adjustments post-corpus integration.

primitives.name: Empirical Situational Evaluator Wiring
primitives.verbatim_quote: Simultaneously, game-context.ts (lines 980–1080), scoring.ts (lines 918–932), and index.ts (lines 640–665) were expanded to wire four empirical situational evaluators directly into Spread, Total, and Moneyline factor breakdowns: evaluateHighAltitudeFatigueDecay, evaluateRefereeCrewTendencies, evaluateRedZonePersonnelGrouping, and evaluateCoachingTendencies.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Spread: points; Total: points; Moneyline: implied probability; Evaluators: dimensionless feature vectors
primitives.assumptions: Physical, schematic, and behavioral contexts exert independent, measurable pressure on standard betting markets.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if evaluator outputs exhibit high multicollinearity with existing Layer-1 market pricing.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to the injection of orthogonal feature spaces into the core probabilistic state machine.
layer2.telemetry: Factor contribution scores per market leg.

primitives.name: Decision-Time Re-Pricing Delta
primitives.verbatim_quote: The resulting price delta is formulated as: \Delta_{\text{price}} = P_{t_{\text{read}}} - P_{t_{\text{slip}}} This \Delta_{\text{price}} scalar is stamped onto the ingestion record and routed directly into Layer-2 situational scoring via computeLineMovementScore.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: \Delta_{\text{price}}: points or decimal odds shift; P_{t_{\text{read}}}: live market price at read time; P_{t_{\text{slip}}}: historical slip price
primitives.assumptions: Live market tape accurately reflects current aggregate syndicate intelligence.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularities occur during extreme liquidity droughts where P_{t_{\text{read}}} fails to reflect true consensus.

layer2.mapping: Calculates the exact Closing Line Value (CLV) consumed prior to ingestion, preventing alpha decay.
layer2.telemetry: Magnitude of \Delta_{\text{price}} relative to initial public lines.

primitives.name: Fail-Closed Entity Resolution
primitives.verbatim_quote: When canonical entity mapping cannot establish an exact bijective match for a player prop or parlay leg, the resolver flags the leg as UNMATCHED or MISSING_INPUT, resolves remaining valid legs transparently, and is mathematically barred from hallucinating or interpolating an approximate line.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Entity Match: Boolean; Leg Status: Enum {VALID, UNMATCHED, MISSING_INPUT}
primitives.assumptions: Bookmaker taxonomies are structurally divergent but logically reducible to a canonical schema.
primitives.breakdown_regime: System halts ingestion for a specific leg if bijective mapping confidence falls below absolute certainty.

layer2.mapping: Enforces strict data integrity boundaries, acting as a veto layer against hallucinated inputs in multimodal OCR pipelines.
layer2.telemetry: Rate of UNMATCHED flags across DraftKings/FanDuel/Caesars taxonomies.

primitives.name: Contextual Literature Premise Index
primitives.verbatim_quote: IN index idx_lit_premises_context_gin over the canonical view v_class_a_literature_premises (WHERE record_class = 'CITABLE_VERIFIED' AND citable = TRUE AND verification_tier = 'MSVH_S1_EXACT' AND status = 'ACTIVE').
primitives.assumptions: All premises are verified and citable; indexed under canonical view for retrieval.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Active records only, filtered by MSVH_S1_EXACT tier.

primitives.name: Class-A HNSW Graph Traversal
primitives.verbatim_quote: In Stage B (Multi-Layer pgvector HNSW Graph Traversal, reducing \sim 2,500 \to 250 candidates in <1.5\text{ ms}), each Class-A premise embedding \mathbf{v}_i \in \mathbb{R}^{1024} is indexed in idx_lit_premises_class_a_hnsw (m = 24, \text{ef\_construction} = 200, scale multiplier m_L = 1/\ln(24) \approx 0.3147).
primitives.assumptions: Embeddings are normalized; HNSW parameters fixed for performance.

layer2.mapping: Performs efficient nearest neighbor search in high-dimensional space using HNSW graph structure.

primitives.name: Bridge Dual-Frequency Spectral Routing
primitives.verbatim_quote: In Stage C (BRIDGE Dual-Frequency Spectral Routing, reducing 250 \to 50 active mechanisms in <1.2\text{ ms}), to prevent cosine over-alignment from suppressing high-frequency situational nuances, arxiv-hnsw-bridge.ts applies Dual-Frequency Graph Evidence (DFGE) over the normalized context-premise bipartite graph \hat{\mathbf{A}}_{ui} = \mathbf{D}^{-1/2}\mathbf{A}_{ui}\mathbf{D}^{-1/2}.
primitives.assumptions: Graph evidence is normalized; DFGE prevents loss of high-frequency details.

layer2.mapping: Applies spectral decomposition to extract low/mid/high frequency components for nuanced causal modeling.

primitives.name: Symbolic Jacobian-Hessian Coupling
primitives.verbatim_quote: In Stage D (Cross-Equation Symbolic Jacobians and Second-Order Hessian Couplings), rather than summing isolated premise deltas linearly, all 50,000 formulas across Clusters M1 through M6 are compiled into typed symbolic operators v_{\text{out}(i)} = f_i(\mathbf{v}_{\text{in}(i)}; \beta_i).
primitives.assumptions: Formulas are typed and compiled symbolically; coupling enables nonlinear interaction modeling.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Handles 50,000 symbolic operators across clusters M1–M6.

layer2.mapping: Encodes causal relationships between inputs and outputs via symbolic differentials, enabling state transition modeling in GSE.
layer2.telemetry: Nonlinear coupling of 50K formulas across clusters

primitives.name: Dual-Speed Synaptic Plasticity
primitives.verbatim_quote: Dual-Speed Synaptic Plasticity: Orthogonal TTT Fast Weights and ReHarness Continual Memory Standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures never alter internal model weights, while naive continual fine-tuning suffers from catastrophic forgetting of physical and mathematical laws.
primitives.assumptions: Model weights remain fixed during standard RAG operations; fast weights enable transient adaptation without permanent modification.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Catastrophic forgetting occurs when model weights are updated naively in continual learning settings.

layer2.mapping: TTT fast weights map to GSE's dynamic attention mechanism; ReHarness memory aligns with GSI's episodic recall kernel.
layer2.telemetry: Memory retention vs. adaptation rate under continual training protocols.

primitives.name: ReHarness Continual Learning
primitives.verbatim_quote: In parallel, ReHarness (arXiv:2610.12668v1) prevents overgeneralized reflections (such as "WR1 injury boosts WR2 targets") from persisting in memory and misleading future decisions via a two-step recurrent loop over harness state h_t = \{R_i\}_{i < t}.
primitives.assumptions: Overgeneralizations arise due to lack of contextual filtering in memory retrieval; iterative revision corrects these errors.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure to revise erroneous patterns leads to persistent misgeneralization in decision-making.

layer2.mapping: Two-step loop maps to GSE's feedback control architecture; harness state h_t corresponds to GSI's episodic memory buffer.
layer2.telemetry: Reduction in false-positive reflection propagation across sequential queries.

primitives.name: M-DoT-PFN Causal Modeling
primitives.verbatim_quote: To model both betting markets and in-game trajectories as continuous-time stochastic processes, packages/prediction-engine/src/causal/continuous-time-cpfn.ts integrates the Continuous-Time Causal Prior-Data Fitted Network (CT-CPFN / M-DoT-PFN) of Thumm and Chen (Oct 8, 2026, arXiv:2610.12537v1) alongside Causal POMDP policy evaluation (CausalPPO, arXiv:2512.18135v1).
primitives.assumptions: Interventions can be modeled as time-varying causal effects; continuous-time dynamics require state-space representations.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Observational bias arises when confounders are not properly accounted for in discrete-time models.

layer2.mapping: M-DoT-PFN maps to GSE's interventional policy evaluation framework; CausalPPO aligns with GSI's action selection logic.
layer2.telemetry: Bias reduction in estimated causal impacts compared to observational regressions.

reasoning_traces.think:
The architectural evolution detailed in pages 1 through 4 represents a fundamental paradigm shift from passive observation to active, production-wired probabilistic modeling. Historically, sports analytics relied heavily on Layer-1 market consensus, treating closing lines as infallible oracles. However, the September 28 staleness audit exposed a critical vulnerability: the ingestion of stale market opinions without temporal re-evaluation. The introduction of the Price Rule, formalized by the equation \Delta_{\text{price}} = P_{t_{\text{read}}} - P_{t_{\text{slip}}}, establishes a rigorous mathematical framework for quantifying consumed Closing Line Value (CLV). This ensures that external directional opinions, whether harvested from TailMe or Action Network, are strictly evaluated against live exchange tape, effectively neutralizing the risk of chasing exhausted syndicate steam.

Furthermore, the excision of zero-weight suppression on corpusAdjustment signifies a doctrinal commitment to empirical situational priors. By dynamically setting corpusWeight to 1.0, the engine integrates verified literature—such as altitude fatigue decay or referee crew tendencies—directly into the ranking probability matrix. This is not merely an additive adjustment but a multiplicative modulation of the de-vigged market baseline. Concurrently, the implementation of fail-closed entity resolution addresses the chaotic reality of bookmaker taxonomy divergence. By mathematically barring interpolation when bijective matches fail, the system prioritizes epistemic integrity over completeness. This triad of innovations—temporal re-pricing, dynamic corpus weighting, and strict entity resolution—collectively constructs a robust Layer-2 cognitive architecture capable of extracting sustainable predictive alpha in a highly efficient market environment.
